caption: Kinderdijk windmills, Kinderdijk
composition: Both Kinderdijk rows: staggered brick Nederwaard mills and straight thatched Overwaard mills · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: At Kinderdijk two canals run side by side, split by the grass Middelkade. The western canal carries eight round red-brick Nederwaard tower mills in a staggered line. The eastern canal carries eight octagonal thatched Overwaard mills in a straight line. It is night, about 20.1°C, under full cloud with light drizzle. No flower display is shown.
